blocks.text: Predicates can represent relationships between objects in the real world. For example, Borrows(x, y) means “student x borrows book y,” and Teaches(t, s) means “teacher t teaches student s.” These predicates clearly describe how students, books, and teachers are connected. Using such relationships, we can model the working of the library system. This makes it easier to organize and understand interactions between different entities.
